title: 3918. Sum of Primes Between Number and Its Reverse

examples.explanation: The reverse of 13 is 31. Thus, the range is [13, 31]. The prime numbers in this range are 13, 17, 19, 23, 29, and 31. The sum of these prime numbers is 13 + 17 + 19 + 23 + 29 + 31 = 132.
The reverse of 10 is 1. Thus, the range is [1, 10]. The prime numbers in this range are 2, 3, 5, and 7. The sum of these prime numbers is 2 + 3 + 5 + 7 = 17.
The reverse of 8 is 8. Thus, the range is [8, 8]. There are no prime numbers in this range, so the sum is 0.
